summary: Gopher Resource is the display name of Gopher Resource, LLC, one existing ECP portfolio company. ECP's Fund IV-A vehicle acquired it in a transaction announced January 30, 2018 and closed March 6, 2018; a 2025 federal disclosure names ECP Gopher Holdings, LP as its sole immediate parent. The record should add the fund/holdco attribution, official website and Eagan headquarters while keeping facilities, subsidiaries and operated county sites subordinate. The 2020 internal HSR notice and 2024 refinancing are not outside-party exits.
